comment: Locale-independent HTML element ids exposed by Teams through AXDOMIdentifier. These are Microsoft's internal ids and can change without notice — that is why they live in data rather than in Swift source. Re-derive with the axprobe tool if detection stops working. Verified against Teams 26213.1006.5011.1671 on macOS 26.6.1, 2026-08-25.

inMeeting.comment: Any one of these confirms an active call. call-duration-custom is the strongest: it is present for the whole call and survives the control bar auto-hiding.

joining.comment: Pre-join / lobby screen. A 26-second lobby was measured. UNVERIFIED: these ids are inferred, not observed — the lobby was captured before markers were instrumented. Absence simply means no joining state is reported.
